status_rule: A required surface passes only when every required state cell passes. Missing evidence never passes.
cell_instantiation_gate: Every listed state has a stable baseline cell. Before implementation begins for a surface, split compound requirements into explicit child cells and instantiate every applicable contextual and execution dimension. A surface passes only when every resulting required execution passes.

surfaces.title: Alliance and Imperial command-center shells
surfaces.current_implementation: P46A renders STRATEGY 900/901 on one centered, uniformly scaled 640x480 canvas, crops the 481st source row, applies the recovered faction apertures, and shares their transform across map layers, hit tests, blockades, and advisors. Authentic controls, the reference rail, GID and map art, original system windows, message and status surfaces, and other required aperture content remain open.

surfaces.title: Galaxy display and Galactic Information Display modes
surfaces.current_implementation: P47A and P47B restore original STRATEGY 902/903 Display Off and Popular Support backdrops, exact faction GID control pairs, compact 10168 legend, and supported marker families and thresholds. P48 adds a source-mapped code-built GID root and submenu with all 22 recovered commands, original faction menu icons, provisional non-support filter metrics, and a test-only 38-scenario browser matrix. P50 restores the STRATEGY 10100 through 10107 frame tiles to both menu layers and removes the invented fade. P51 removes an unsupported row-hover wash and checks source frame pixels that remain visible beneath a system window. The 152 muted faction/viewport probes are an implementation regression gate, not original acceptance. Unsupported special marker overlays and an invented expanded legend were withheld after independent review. Menu interior, original hover/focus states, typography, exact geometry, non-support predicates, mixed-fleet allegiance, type-specific idle facilities, original floating legend, HQ/blockade/mission/Death Star states, native equivalence, keyboard focus, and full A0 composition remain open.

surfaces.title: Sector and system-management windows
surfaces.current_implementation: UIP-B01 replaces the custom right SidePanel with original 235x360 sector and 226x304 detailed-system shells. Original planet pictures, placement, relationship title art, six core tab resource families, close, sector return, double-click routing, foreground focus, and pointer occlusion work in both factions. P46D adds source-mapped GOKRES miniatures, displayed entity labels, bounded original-scrollbar navigation, and coarse current-intelligence gating. Nested compositions, exact intelligence semantics, commands, indicators, uncommon states, and the full A0/browser matrix remain open.

surfaces.title: Window-reference rail and modeless window manager
surfaces.current_implementation: UIP-B01 implements modeless focus and close plus faction-specific 12-slot minimize and restore routing with preserved tab, selected item, scroll row, and window position. Detailed-system windows retain foreground ownership over sector windows. Exact active and inactive rail thumbnails and the complete A0 multiwindow/browser matrix remain open.

surfaces.title: Primary strategic command controls
surfaces.current_implementation: P46B removes the synthetic text-button strip and renders the six faction-specific primary STRATEGY bitmap pairs at their exact recovered rectangles. Press capture, release cancellation, strict outer-edge rejection, indexed palette-key hit masks, F2 through F5, and F7 follow the native state machine. P47B adds the exact faction GID control pairs and rectangles under the same input contract and recognizes command 0x133 without inventing its still-open destination menu. Input resolves after floating content so covered controls do not receive clicks. The six primary commands are recognized, but none opens a replacement panel while its original destination window remains pending. The replacement message and status bars are withheld because they covered original control apertures.
